headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal to offload three players, with Atlético Madrid keen
description: Atlético Madrid are one of the main clubs showing an interest in Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi, while Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino could also depart. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Xavi Simons reveals emotional toll of Spurs ACL injury as return nears
description: Injured Tottenham attacker Xavi Simons has spoken of the anguish he felt watching the club's relegation battle last season, but is working "endless hours" to return for Roberto De Zerbi's side.

headline: Virgil van Dijk: 'No panic' over uncertain Liverpool future
description: Virgil van Dijk has said he is "not in any panic" about his Liverpool future despite the fact his contract is set to expire next summer.

headline: Man United executives, Sir Jim Ratcliffe meeting to discuss Carrick future - sources
description: Manchester United executives are meeting with minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe this week to discuss Michael Carrick's future as head coach, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Sources: Man United turn to U.S. coach Pochettino with Carrick on the brink
description: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favored candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager, sources have told ESPN.
